_comment: Funding news for `leadengine ingest news` (ingest/src/leadengine/news.py; design 7.1 and 7.4, 'Signals'). Each feed and the GDELT query are fetched through the polite fetcher, so robots.txt is respected, requests are paced and counted, and a feed that refuses or fails is counted and skipped. Check each feed URL still answers with RSS or Atom when the command is first run (`leadengine ingest news --dry-run`), and after a publisher redesigns its site. GDELT DOC 2.0 API: GET https://api.gdeltproject.org/api/v2/doc/doc?query=...&mode=artlist&format=json&maxrecords=N&timespan=1d, answering {"articles": [{"url", "title", "seendate", "domain"}]}; check that shape on the first live run. funding_words is a Python regular expression, case ignored: a headline is read further only if it matches (money, a round or the word funding; the verbs alone are not enough, so 'X raises concerns' is not funding news). Only headlines that name exactly one UP company become a proposed signal, for a person to confirm or reject in the Admin pages.

gdelt.query: (raises OR raised OR funding OR "seed round" OR "pre-seed") (Lucknow OR Noida OR Kanpur OR Ghaziabad OR Varanasi OR Prayagraj OR Agra OR Meerut OR Gorakhpur OR "Uttar Pradesh") sourcecountry:india sourcelang:english
